## Change

<!-- Explain the problem and what changes for the user or system. Link the work item. -->

## Verification

<!-- Evidence beyond required GitHub checks: what behavior was exercised, where, and with what result? State relevant unverified behavior and its blocker. Omit required check results; they are visible in Checks. -->

## Evidence

<!-- For visual changes, attach screenshots/a recording or link directly to evidence. Caption the screen/state, platform/viewport and before/after where useful. Verify the attachment exists. Remove this section when not relevant. -->

## Reviewer notes

<!-- Specific risks, decisions, affected services/platforms, API/client impact, migrations/configuration, dependencies or follow-up work. Include rollout/rollback details only when needed. Remove this section when there is nothing useful to add. -->
